craft_claim: Nostalgia chosen feels different from nostalgia that ambushes you: experimentally elicited recollections improve well-being, while spontaneous daily-life nostalgia covaries negatively with it and can trend into rumination and sadness. Dosage rule - keep the reader's nostalgic attention invited and bounded by a concrete trigger, never ambient and inescapable.

supporting_evidence.location: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology 118(2):325-347, Studies 2-5
supporting_evidence.note: With daily-diary measurement, state nostalgia was negatively related to well-being; lagged analyses showed mixed effects later the same day and negative effects the following day, with daily nostalgia predicting increased rumination and sadness. Study 5 reconciles the literature: experimentally induced nostalgic recollections are rated more positive and less negative than naturally occurring nostalgia.

supporting_evidence.location: Frontiers in Psychology 11:1186, abstract and discussion
supporting_evidence.note: Anticipatory nostalgia - missing the present before it has become past - is characterized by difficulty enjoying the present and a tendency toward sadness and worry; when nostalgia is pointed at the present or future rather than the past, it tilts maladaptive.

counterevidence.location: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology 91(5):975-993, Studies 5-7
counterevidence.note: Elicited nostalgic recollection reliably increases positive affect, self-regard, and social bonds in the lab - the opposite valence profile. The reconciliation is method, not contradiction: chosen, cued nostalgia helps; ambient, involuntary nostalgia can hurt.

scope: Dosage and pacing rules for sustained nostalgic passages; feeds card dosage section.
exceptions: Tragedy and grief-adjacent passages may deliberately run ambient nostalgia as dysphoria - but then the piece has left pure tone work and entered another register (elegiac, elegy).
